laws: R1 circuits reference registered Capital LEGOs and may not invent implementation ownership

circuit compilation does not grant authority, execute nodes, infer risk appetite, rank scenarios, or establish semantic completion

receipt binds mechanical node outputs and unresolved evidence obligations without promoting execution success to financial truth
